existing_harness.live_policy: selective-artifact-backed; deterministic CI must not require a proprietary provider

metric_rule: Counts are derived from executed deterministic ordinary-route traces and checked against the committed measurement artifact; scenario authors maintain budgets, not observed values. Selective live runs may add observations but cannot silently replace deterministic evidence.

measurement.trace_rule: Each result is recomputed through discovery, ownership/compatibility admission, the ordinary startup posture packet, and any routed operation; first-line bytes and all counts come from those emitted events.

exact_base_disposition.boundary: Neither failure exercises module discovery, relevance, contribution, operation, measurement, or extension-author topology; they remain foundation routing residue and are not introduced or widened by #2626.

final_review.agent_use_cost: Relevant capability adds one bounded contribution; irrelevant, removed, incompatible, and conflicting modules do not broaden first contact or authorize proof/claims.
final_review.independent_author_cost: The fixture owns its identity and domain behind one entry point; the ledger records no fixture-specific runtime, registry, skill, phase, proof, or closeout edit.
